theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_mm_limsup_le_of_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ limsup (fun i => μs (ψ (φ' i)) W) atTop ≤ μ W) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
